test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On: 25 May 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Three Statements are given followed by Three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All books are copies.

No copy is a pen.

Some erasers are books.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some copies are erasers.

II. Some pens are books.

III. No eraser is a pen.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow.
Both conclusions I and III follow.

solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c8613710ff01d1d240bd47ad2bb9abf18e383f1f262d675eeaf7ecb3a62da0e3.png] 

Here, it is given that all books are copies. 

I. Some copies are erasers → Follow → (As all books are copies and some eraser are books. So, some copies are erasers is followed
